shortDescription: BlockBeats reported on September 13 that a whale identified as BS3YsB bought 15.06 million STONK yesterday at an average price of $0.295, spending 4.4 million USDC. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the transaction was monitored by Lookonchain.
